local-compose.implementation: Docker Compose + local Postgres/PgBouncer + Dapr service invocation and Redis-backed pub/sub + OSS observability
local-compose.purpose: Fast local iteration and workload contract proof without production runtime dependencies.

authn.realization: No authentication by default for local inner-loop workloads; workloads may use an explicit static dev token when the workload contract declares one.

authz.realization: Business authorization stays in the workload or application layer when a local workload needs it.

service_identity.realization: Docker Compose service name and network membership identify local workload hosts; Dapr-enabled workloads also use a stable Dapr app identity.

secrets.realization: Environment variables and local mounted files only; no committed secret values.

observability.realization: Workloads emit Prometheus metrics, structured logs, and optional OTLP traces; the local runtime routes them to the OSS stack.

network.realization: Internal connectivity is Docker Compose networking; public host ports are explicit in compose.yaml.

ci_cd.realization: Local validation runs through Makefile targets and pytest; cloud-changing delivery is not part of local-compose.

policy.realization: OPA/Conftest validates repository contracts and platform metadata; it is not app business authorization.

local-kubernetes.purpose: Richer local workload contract proof for network, storage, compute, probes, jobs, service identity, and runtime policy without cloud Kubernetes machinery.

authn.realization: No authentication by default for inner-loop proof; workloads that declare static bearer auth can enforce a configured Kubernetes Secret value.

authz.realization: Business authorization stays in the workload or application layer when a local Kubernetes workload needs it.

service_identity.realization: Kubernetes namespace, service account, service name, and pod labels identify local workload hosts.

secrets.realization: Local Kubernetes injects declared secret names from Kubernetes Secrets; checked-in values are local placeholders only.

observability.realization: Workloads expose Prometheus metrics and structured logs through standard endpoints and pod logs; full observability backend remains optional.

network.realization: Kubernetes Services, readiness probes, liveness probes, and in-cluster DNS prove local network boundaries.

ci_cd.realization: Local validation runs through Make targets that build images, create or reuse kind, load images, apply manifests, smoke test, and clean up.

policy.realization: OPA/Conftest validates repository contracts and pytest validates local Kubernetes manifests against the workload contract.

aws-ecs.implementation: AWS ECS/Fargate + ALB/WAF + RDS + SNS/SQS + S3 + EventBridge Scheduler
aws-ecs.purpose: Current reviewed production realization of the workload contract.

authn.realization: The current primary edge declares static-bearer-token and the workload host enforces it; ALB forwards HTTPS traffic to the workload.

authz.realization: Business authorization stays in application/workload behavior unless a shared runtime policy owner and conformance path exist.

service_identity.realization: ECS task roles provide runtime identity; GitHub OIDC provides short-lived delivery identity.

secrets.realization: Declared workload secret names are injected by ECS from Secrets Manager or SSM; values are not committed or baked into images.

observability.realization: Apps emit standard metrics/logs/traces; AWS runtime edge routes to CloudWatch and ADOT-compatible collectors where enabled.

network.realization: ALB owns public ingress for edge workloads; internal services and data dependencies stay behind VPC networking and security groups.

ci_cd.realization: GitHub Actions uses OIDC, immutable image tags, separated build/deploy, reviewed plan/apply, and release evidence.

policy.realization: OPA/Conftest validates platform metadata and workflows; app-local authorization remains the default until runtime policy ownership exists.
